title: Apfels Hats
description: A simple Resource pack that adds Hats that can be accessed by naming a Carved Pumpkin in an Anvil
body:
keep in mind that this is my first ever RELEASED resource pack
Hats list:
- 3D Glassses Anvil name: 3D Glasses
- Chicken Hat Anvil name: Chicken Hat

Im the only person working on this Resource Pack so it will take a bit for more Hats to come. But when they do i will release a new version for it:)
